title: Tenma Saki — Rainy Distance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was a nice meal!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, we still have some time before lunch break is over. What should we do?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's too short for us to go over to SEKAI for some practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, let's think about where we should go for our next outing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good idea. We have just enough time to do that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, what about the astronomical observatory?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That event won't be held again for some time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we already had our play-planetarium session in SEKAI, so let's save it for another day!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, somewhere other than an astronomical observatory?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, Saki, is there anywhere you want to go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll be honest... The aquarium!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, the place Kiritani was telling us about?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Apparently, the penguin petting corner is only a limited time event!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh, penguins... That does sound interesting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Totally, right?
All of you should share with us the places you're keen to visit too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, it's a little far, but I was hoping we could go to the shopping tower together too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! That huge place that's at least three times bigger than the usual shopping malls?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. They hold events like band performances and idol live shows there during holidays too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sounds great! There's sure to be enough things for us to see and do for an entire day in such a big place!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If we're going to be out for an entire day...wouldn't it be better to go to Phoenix Wonderland instead?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a huge fan of Phoenix Wonderland, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is it because there are new Pheeny mascots being released?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What makes you say that? I'm only mentioning it because Tsukasa said something about performing there when we were at Saki's place.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, let's leave it as that, then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Mhm... Everything sounds good.
I wanna visit them all!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, why don't we do just that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not in a single day, of course, but it should be completely doable if we go on an outing once every month.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, that's a reasonable pace that won't affect our practice or part-time jobs, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Going on an outing once every month means we'll be able to cover all those places mentioned just now in three months.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Three months... That's pretty long, but I'm sure time will pass by really quickly if I keep thinking about how I can go out with everyone soon!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's right. Whether it's a place that you want to visit or we want to visit, we'll go to them all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. If we prepare well and draw up a good schedule, we should be able to do everything we want to.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll go along with that. We're childhood friends, after all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, Hona, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so lucky to have such wonderful childhood friends with me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Flattering us won't get you anything, you know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on, that's not what I was after!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, Hona, and Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's stay together forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (From now on, I'll keep treasuring every single day that I get to be together with them.)
